short.modelAnswer:
The system of instruction determines the design and organization of the workshop.
1. Teacher-centered: theory in a classroom with movable chairs and desks. About 2.5 square meters per student. Each student has a workspace. An area for group demonstration is needed.
2. Student-centered (self-paced): students progress independently. Needs an adequately-equipped workshop and a separate resource area.
